## Why

Wave A's live legs are authorised only inside 2026-10-19→23
14:00–20:00Z under ING-GO-A, and GATE-G4's 11B OM-20 never-list
explicitly keeps P35.11 out of pre-authorisation. This run lands the
**engineering half**: the scripted runbook, the leg gate, the driver,
the tribal screened-lane registrations and the fixture proofs — every
live leg stays queued and honestly reported, never executed early.

## What ships

- **`ops/src/ops/wave_a.py`** — the `sig.wave-a-gate/1` go/no-go
  evaluator over **recorded** inputs (never live state): ING-GO-A
  verbatim + recorded_at · the 2026-10-19→23 14:00–20:00Z window on a
  supplied instant · leg order (`completed` must be the ordered prefix —
  a missed leg refuses, never skips) · declared scope
  (`doj_ctas_awards` refused always) · the screened lane admits only
  flip-listed + disclosed sources · the Legistar-trigger mitigation
  (paused, or roll ≥ the 2026-10-20 05:00Z fire) · serialisation (no
  `sig-materialize`, one manual run at a time) · L1's AR-2 backup +
  OM-14 prestate. Plus `sig.wave-a-plan/1` — the deterministic step
  plan (prestate → backup → mitigate → roll → load-seed → manual runs
  each verified → screened contingent → +0 → resume).
- **`sig-ops wave-a-gate` / `sig-ops wave-a-plan`** — CLI wiring
  (exit 0 go / 42 no-go-queued / 2 usage).
- **`ops/gcp/wave-a.sh`** — the check/apply driver:
  `--check` prints the plan + gate-inputs template with no ADC and no
  network; `--apply --leg <L1|L2|L3> --inputs <json>` gates first
  (no-go → exit 42), then executes the leg's steps serially — the
  trigger pause, `sig-ops roll-jobs --record` on the pinned digest,
  `sig-connectors load-seed --source state_alpr_statute_inventory_2026`,
  per-source `gcloud run jobs execute … --wait` with a run-row +
  execution read between every run, contingent screened steps for
  flip-listed sources only, and L3 resumes only triggers whose sources
  ran green.
- **`docs/build/reports/WAVE_A_RUNBOOK.md`** — the contract, criteria,
  step order, verification reads, rollback, exclusions and the re-run
  prompt.
- **Tribal S8 screened lane (ADR-185, facts + citations only):**
  - `camreg_tribal_all_leaders_directory` (AP-T2-201) — routed through
    `dossier_documents` `clause_fields` over the BIA layer's own
    ArcGIS REST metadata page (stated name + verbatim use disclaimer).
    The 601-row `arcgis_query` is a recorded **non-target** outcome in
    `camera_registry_targets.toml` (`[[enumerated]] status =
    "screened_lane"`) — leader name/phone/email fields are never read;
    row-level ingestion stays behind
    `CG-LATER-tribal-data-governance-rule-i7-new-6` (OPEN).
  - `legis_tribal_tohono_oodham_notice` (AP-T2-210) — `dossier_documents`
    `clause_fields` over the single published hearing-notice PDF:
    committee, the two technology names (LGDS, Automated Surveillance
    Tower), the hearing date. The named chairperson is never emitted
    (institutional-role name; Part VIII person-name guard).
  - Both rows `ingestion_permitted=false`, rights unresolved — the
    screened lane is no rights or governance clearance.
  - Cadence rows on day 24 **after** the window (created `--paused`;
    first fire can never precede the verified manual run).
  - Committed stand-in fixtures (HTML layer-metadata page + minimal
    parseable notice PDF) + `test_tribal_screened_lane.py` (9 tests):
    gated posture, routing, facts/citations-only claims, the absent
    chairperson, no person/phone/email predicates, jurisdiction
    scoping, deterministic replay — no network.

#### Test plan

- Gate: go on green inputs; refuse on missing/blank ING-GO-A, every
  window edge (before/after/out-of-band/exclusive end), wrong or
  out-of-order `completed`, unknown leg, `doj_ctas_awards` and
  undeclared sources in `run_set`, screened-but-unflipped,
  screened-but-undisclosed, unpaused trigger before the 10-20 05:00Z
  fire (and the after-fire admission), active materialize/manual run,
  failed/missing backup, missing/red prestate; L2/L3 free of the
  L1-only criteria.
- Plan: legs ordered L1→L2→L3; the three manual sources in order each
  followed by a verify; screened steps marked `contingent`; the seed
  source + legistar trigger named; `doj_ctas_awards` absent.
- Tribal lane: both sources non-granting and gated (loader refusal);
  routing to `dossier_documents`; BIA emits screened metadata
  facts/citations only; the Tohono notice emits committee +
  technology + date and never the chairperson; jurisdiction scoping;
  deterministic replay + typed assertion envelope; no network.

## Closeout note — build-memory budgets

Post-CI the committed-state validators flagged two budget failures,
both repaired in the closeout commit with no semantic change:

- `returnPass:` (generated id list, irreducible at 35 keys) rides the
  B3 V2 512 B hard bound via a keyed cap (`RP_LINE_MAX` in
  `ledger_contract.py` + the same keyed cap in
  `check-build-memory.sh`); every other CURRENT STATE line keeps
  256 B.
- The orient probe (53,881 B → ≤ 48 KiB) was restored by compacting
  `return_pass.toml` cells while keeping every validator-pinned
  substring (go refs, operator payloads, excluded/clock tokens,
  re-run prompts) and regenerating the LEDGER region.

`return_pass.py check`, `ledger_contract.py check`,
`check-build-memory.sh`, `make docs-check` and the current-state
projection all re-verified green.
